metadata.title: CRA Agent · Credit Review Workbench
metadata.description: A traceable agent workbench for CRA Excel intake, entity verification, financial evidence, risk review and workbook handoff.
metadata.keywords: CRA, business credit, financial review, Agent, RAG

sign.sign_in_description: Sign in with a registered account. Access is loaded from its database role.
sign.workspace_sign_in_title: Enter a credit review flow built for evidence and sign-off
sign.workspace_sign_in_description: Every account has a defined responsibility boundary. Analysts prepare evidence, reviewers sign controlled gates, and administrators manage users and access.
sign.workflow_summary: Case work, human sign-off, and historical RAG are separated by role
sign.demo_accounts_description: Choose an account to fill its email. You still enter the private password.
sign.demo_admin_permissions: All CRA features plus user and permission management
sign.demo_analyst_permissions: Case intake, evidence work, draft editing, and policy RAG
sign.demo_reviewer_permissions: Analyst access, human sign-off, and historical-case RAG
sign.permissions_follow_account: This page never grants access. Effective permissions come from the user's PostgreSQL role.
sign.sign_in_network_error: The sign-in service is unavailable. Confirm the project is running, refresh, and try again.
sign.sign_in_credentials_error: The email or password is incorrect. Please try again.
sign.demo_credentials_error: The password is incorrect. Demo account shortcuts only fill in the email; enter the password used when the account was registered.
sign.sign_in_failed: Sign-in failed. Please try again shortly.
sign.session_without_access: The signed-in account {email} does not have CRA workspace access. Sign out and use an account with an assigned role.
sign.switch_account_failed: The current session could not be ended. Please try again.
sign.email_auth_unavailable: Email and password sign-in is disabled in this environment, so demo account shortcuts are hidden.
